description.value: The Stonebridge Hotel sits at the famous Mile 0 of the Alaska Highway in Dawson Creek, making it a natural stopping point for touring cyclists tackling one of North America's great adventure routes. The full-service property includes an on-site restaurant (Fixx Urban Grill), a pool with waterslide, hot tub, and 24-hour fitness centre. Pet-friendly rooms and suites ranging from standard queens to full kitchenette suites give cyclists flexibility for longer stays.

address.value: 500 Highway 2, Dawson Creek, British Columbia V1G 0A4
